resources.string: Place phone flat against your chest over your sternum. Breathe gently.
Place phone on chest over sternum and rest index finger gently on rear camera flash.
Camera and flash access is needed for photoplethysmography (PPG) pulse transit sensing.
Sit comfortably or lie down on your back. Rest for 2 minutes before starting to ensure a steady resting heart rate.
Place the phone flat against your bare chest or light shirt, directly over your lower sternum (center of your chest). Keep completely still.
For Blood Pressure & PTT mode, place your index finger gently over the rear camera lens and flash without pressing too hard.
You can press the Volume-Down key to toggle recording without looking at the screen!
